visibility.isolation: SQLite WAL gives every read a consistent committed snapshot.
visibility.node_serialization: All drain transitions for one node are serialized by a single-writer lock; different nodes may analyze concurrently.
visibility.pdb_commit_gate: A short process-wide commit gate plus SQLite conditional updates prevents two drains from committing a PDB decrement below its required lower bound.
visibility.publish_rule: A step becomes query-visible only in the transaction that changes its status from STEP_INTENT to COMMITTED and applies all affected PDB decrements. Intent rows are hidden.
visibility.batch_visibility: A RUNNING drain may expose committed prefix steps, but never a partial allowed decision whose PDB decrements are not yet committed. Final allowed/blocked lists are published only when the drain becomes COMPLETED.
visibility.idempotency: The same request_id is executed once. Concurrent duplicates wait and reuse the persisted drain result; a completed replay does not reapply PDB decrements.
visibility.recovery: After an abrupt stop, uncommitted intent rows are ABORTED and PDB availability is rebuilt from initial availability minus committed allowed steps.
